subject: UI C2 run: chronod nil-encoder crash proven; backboardd on SW renderer
body:
C2 UI run (c2-test/ui-usb). Sources: render_encoder.inc a1d201fd, nord2_render_pass.inc 7e09399c. Offline: iOS16.7 dyld cache extracted locally to build/frontend-audit-ui-c2-20261025/dsc (private, not published); slide 0x19190000.
PROVEN (disassembly/log):
1) chronod pc=0: lr 0x1ffa41a00 = RenderBox+0xba00 (unslid 0x1e68b1a00), fn 0x1e68b1704. At +0x18b8 it calls -renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor: with NO nil check, then caches 14 IMPs via [enc methodForSelector:] (helper 0x1e68bb790: drawPrimitives, drawIndexed, setScissorRect, setRenderPipelineState, setDepthStencilState, setStencilReferenceValue, set{Vertex,Fragment}{Bytes,Buffer,BufferOffset}, setFragmentTexture, setFragmentSamplerState). nil encoder => all IMPs NULL => blr NULL at +0x19fc (setDepthStencilState:). All 14 selectors exist on TeguRenderEncoder (ws_selector_compat.inc), so cause is the nil return of nord2_render_pass (fail: label = line 47). chronod respawn storm (504 exec/490 CRASH, 39..51s) = widget flicker. Hidden because stderr mirror is only for sweetnull=backboardd,SpringBoard.
2) backboardd never built CA::OGL::MetalContext: ctor calls setBackgroundGPUPriority:2 (0x188488220) then setGPUPriority:4 (0x18848813c) on success; Tegu prints TEGU_FRONTEND UNSUPPORTED for both; neither appears for backboardd; also 0 GPU buffers, 0 pipelines, no TEGU_PIPELINE_CACHE line. So backboardd renders with CA software renderer, as in Metal-OFF image. Device is created (bundle ctor lines + open Nord2GPU).
3) QuartzCore aborts the process if newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor fails after retry (0x188381ef4, string Metal failed to build render pipeline). Nord2 returns nil PSO for unsupported shaders (render_pipeline.inc nord2_render_error).
INFERRED: line-47 cause in chronod = depth/stencil attachment (RB sets loadAction on depth/stencil attachments, uses stencil state, no MSAA selectors); SpringBoard pass = likely Siri 4x MSAA. Blur absence likely same as OFF baseline (SW path) - ask human if OFF image had blur. Exact backboardd ctor soft-fail (only candidates: newCommandQueue nil, or [queue device]!=device) unproven.
FIXES: (1 render, nord2_render_pass.inc) never return nil: TEGU_INVALID(c) + bounded TEGU_PASS_REFUSED line=N detail, return inert encoder (ended=1, setters/draws no-op, nil target safe). Host test (integration_tests): descriptors with stencil/depth texture, sampleCount 4, resolveTexture, color1 mismatch => non-nil encoder, command invalid, the 14 selectors+endEncoding+commit under ASan, status Error. (2 render/textures) decide depth/stencil: accept-and-ignore as R159 (wrong clipping) vs implement. (3 compute/root) next build: -DTEGU_RENDER_TRACE + always-on TEGU_API_NIL for newCommandQueue/queue.device/newLibrary; add chronod to sweetnull boot-arg. (4) do NOT enable CA Metal in backboardd before PSO-nil policy is replaced (would abort backboardd). Also: 281 backboardd IOAcceleratorES matching1 lines occur in OFF baseline too (noise).
